name: 73065 · Newcastle, OK
findings: ZIP 73065 (Newcastle) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73065 (Newcastle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73065 (Newcastle) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
